title: Startup applications
intro: raven.startup replaces the list of applications launched at session startup.

blocks.text: The default list contains Waybar. Saving changes does not start, restart, or stop these applications; the list runs once next session. A missing startup program does not stop the other entries.

blocks.label: Startup entry options
rows: Executable followed by separate arguments. Required in the expanded form.
Working directory. Defaults to Raven’s working directory.
Environment overrides for this application. Raven controls display routing.
